references.text: Mentions Shittim (Abel-Shittim) as a place where the Israelites camped in the plains of Moab
Joshua sent spies from Shittim, confirming that this was the Israelite campsite before they crossed the Jordan
The Israelites broke camp at Shittim to cross the Jordan under Joshua's leadership
Moses warns the Israelites by reminding them of what happened to those who followed Baal-Peor
Explains that it was Midianite women who seduced the Israelites into unfaithfulness at Peor, following Balaam's advice
The psalmist recalls how the Israelites bound themselves to Baal-Peer and ate sacrifices offered to dead gods, which aroused the Lord's anger
Hosea refers to the Baal-Peor incident as a shameful act where Israel dedicated itself to shame
Micah reminds the people of what happened from Shittim to Gilgal, including events linked to Balak and Balaam
John mentions Balaam's teaching that led the Israelites to eat food offered to idols and commit sexual immorality, a direct reference to the events in Moab
Paul warns against sexual immorality by pointing to this incident, where 23,000 fell in one day
